results.title: Concord, One of Gaming’s Most Controversial Flops, Now Sells For Up to $1,000 Online as a Collector’s Item
results.description: The video game 'Concord,' released by Firewalk Studios and Sony Interactive Entertainment, is regarded as a major flop with disastrous sales and a peak of only 697 concurrent players on Steam. Despite its failure and the shutdown of its servers in September 2024, making physical copies useless, these editions have become collector's items, selling for up to $1,000 on platforms like eBay. Although some copies are listed at high prices, others are available at much lower costs, reflecting the game's notoriety and scarcity. Efforts to revive the game through private servers were halted by PlayStation, highlighting the game's enduring intrigue among collectors despite its commercial failure.
